verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a code-hosting platform, but the evidence pack never documents a GitHub instance you can install, configure, upgrade, or maintain on your own infrastructure. The pack describes cloud-hosted features (Codespaces, cloud agent, cloud sandboxes) and local client tools (GitHub CLI, Copilot CLI, GitHub Desktop), and client tools are not a self-hosted server. Community comments about self-hosted Forgejo concern alternatives to GitHub, and the self-hosted-runners remark is a feature request, so neither counts.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can install, configure, upgrade, and maintain my own instance on my infrastructure
